description:
We are a team passionate about space exploration, astronomy, engineering, and technology. For NASA Space Apps 2026, we're building Luned, a lunar mission-planning tool that combines scientific calculations, NASA data, and interactive visualisation to help evaluate landing sites on the Moon.

We're excited to experiment, and turn ambitious ideas into working solutions.

We're looking for: Members with skills in Python, astronomy, physics, data analysis, UI/UX design, 3D visualisation
